en: A black and white postcard showing a large historical castle complex situated near a winding river in a rural landscape. The postcard has German text at the top which identifies the location as Strehla an der Elbe—Schloß, suggesting the image is of a castle (Schloss) near the Elbe river in the town of Strehla. The scene includes the castle buildings surrounded by trees and fields, with the river Elbe visible in the background.
